answers.how: At each site, replace Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=P)) with scratch_dir(P), imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, and drop the tempfile import where nothing else uses it: cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_the_librarian_harvests_cross_domain_questions.py:86 (base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="harvestproof-")), landed under c7cb0de74f71). Precedent: cc_0's 9859b8d64 (ticket 383ac6351996): the LF hook proof took its temp dir from scratch_dir after the scratch-door proof redded its bare mkdtemp. New red-first proof cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_the_librarians_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, the pattern of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py: one tooth test_no_proof_in_the_librarian_reaches_temp_bare asserting bare_temp_reach(REPO / 'cairn/devices/librarian') == [], the scan bound at call time. Proofs-only build: the ticket carries a top-level writes_to.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and these lines step around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
answers.what: Every proof in cairn/devices/librarian takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a the librarian proof makes outlives its run.
